text:
Leo: Quick Q — PR #4821 touches runtime/model-service/handler.py and infra/manifests/model-deploy.yaml. CODEOWNERS maps model-service -> @eng-runtime and infra -> @eng-platform. Who can sign off so we can merge? Need it out before EOD. cc @Maya @Sarah

codeowners-bot: INFO: CODEOWNERS suggests reviewers @eng-runtime, @eng-platform. PR flagged for multi-team approval.

Maya: I can take the runtime review today — it's a pretty small fix. But we need infra approved first or runtime will reference a new env var that doesn't exist yet.

Sarah: I'm platform oncall today, I can look. If the manifest change is just an image tag / add env var, I can approve. If it's k8s API/schema work, I need more time.

Leo: It's image tag bump + adding a single env var. Runtime change is a 3-line handler fix to read that var. No API changes.

Olivia: Release coordination note — if both go in together great, but prefer infra-first so we don't accidentally break CI. Splitting into two PRs could speed approvals.

Maya: Splitting is fine but the runtime PR will fail if the env var isn't present. So infra must merge first.

Sarah: OK — upload looks simple. Can you update the PR description to say "infra-first merge required" and remove unrelated files? I'll review now.

Leo: Done — updated PR description and removed a stray test file. Also added this snippet to the PR to make the order explicit:

```
Merge order (required):
1) infra PR (adds env var + image tag)
2) runtime PR (reads env var)
```

Sarah: Reviewed the manifest changes. No risky k8s changes. Leaving +1 here :+1: (approver). Please tag me after you push the cleaned up infra commit.

Maya: Thanks Sarah — I'll hold on merging runtime until I see infra merged.

Olivia: I'll schedule the deploy window for 06:00 UTC tomorrow and coordinate rollback steps. Once both merges are green, post the checklist here.

Leo: Will do. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

codeowners-bot: NOTE: When PR merges, CODEOWNERS will request approvers from @eng-platform and @eng-runtime as configured.
